waves.title: The Foundational Canon
waves.description: The original vocabulary of Magic: power, color identity, card advantage, removal, finishers, and instantly recognizable fantasy.

waves.title: Early Expansion Icons and Old-School Tournament Magic
waves.description: Early expansion cards that defined collecting, Old School competition, and the first generation of famous archetypes.

waves.title: Ice Age, Alliances, Mirage, and Visions
waves.description: Ice Age through Visions: card selection, tutoring, resource engines, and the rise of recognizable tournament deck construction.

waves.title: Tempest, Stronghold, Exodus, and the Urza Era
waves.description: Tempest and Urza-era engines whose efficiency, degeneracy, or flexibility reshaped every older format.

waves.title: Masques, Invasion, Odyssey, and Onslaught
waves.description: Masques through Onslaught cards that defined major Standard, Extended, Block, and early Legacy archetypes.

waves.title: Onslaught Finishers, Storm, and the Fetchland Revolution
waves.description: Storm, tribal decks, Odyssey engines, wishes, graveyards, and the cards remembered from turn-of-the-century tournament Magic.

waves.title: Mirrodin and Kamigawa
waves.description: Affinity, equipment, prison pieces, iconic legends, and the highly distinctive Mirrodin/Kamigawa period.

waves.title: Ravnica, Time Spiral, and Lorwyn
waves.description: Ravnica, Time Spiral, and Lorwyn cards that established mana bases, planeswalkers, tribal tempo, and future Modern staples.

waves.title: Alara, Zendikar, and Scars of Mirrodin
waves.description: Alara through Scars cards behind Jund, Caw-Blade, Valakut, Twin, Infect, Affinity, and the early Modern identity.

waves.title: Innistrad, Return to Ravnica, Theros, and Khans
waves.description: Innistrad through Khans cards that drove Delver, Miracles, graveyard decks, midrange, devotion, and delve.

waves.title: Battle for Zendikar through Dominaria
waves.description: The energy, vehicle, Marvel, control, red aggro, and midrange cards that defined late-2010s Constructed.

waves.title: Guilds of Ravnica through Commander Legends
waves.description: Bans, companions, food, ramp, Commander products, and cards that changed expectations for contemporary card power.

waves.title: Kaldheim, Strixhaven, Midnight Hunt, and Modern Horizons 2
waves.description: Modern Horizons 2 and adjacent releases that rapidly became pillars of Modern, Legacy, Commander, and Standard.

waves.title: The New Phyrexia War, Middle-earth, and the Modern Horizons 3 Era
waves.description: Recent cards already significant enough to merit historical study, while their ultimate standing remains less settled.

waves.title: Eternal Format Engines, Answers, and Archetype Signatures
waves.description: Combo engines, sideboard institutions, prison tools, and signature pieces from Legacy, Vintage, and other nonrotating formats.

waves.title: Commander Cornerstones and Table Institutions
waves.description: Cards that became institutions of multiplayer deck building, table politics, ramp, protection, removal, and legendary-creature culture.

waves.title: Kitchen-Table Legends and Casual Memory
waves.description: Kitchen-table legends, starter-deck memories, splashy finishers, and cards whose fame exceeded their tournament résumé.

waves.title: Tribal and Typal Mascots
waves.description: Mascots and mechanical anchors for Goblins, Elves, Merfolk, Slivers, Zombies, Humans, Spirits, Angels, and other beloved tribes.

waves.title: Memes, Mistakes, Oddities, and Infamy
waves.description: Memes, mistakes, ante cards, Un-cards, bizarre templating, and notorious designs that became part of Magic folklore.

waves.title: Lands, Mana Bases, and Structural Design Landmarks
waves.description: Mana-base landmarks whose existence changed deck construction, format accessibility, archetype identity, or the rules of resource development.
